The '''tomb''' of the [[The Barsen'thor|third Barsen'thor]], or [[Barsen'thor|Warden]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was located in the [[Crystal Canyons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. With several bridges, ornate pillars, endless abysses, and ancient sculptures of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] holding luminescent [[force crystal]]s, it was well decorated.

==History==
In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], it was reopened by the [[Disciples of Ragnos]], who hoped to siphon the Force energy from the tomb in order to eventually reawaken [[Marka Ragnos]], but they were halted by the [[Mission to Chandrila|timely arrival]] of [[Jaden Korr]].

Korr eliminated the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] in his way, and resealed the casket. Soon after though, the tomb began to collapse, forcing Korr to quickly escape the mausoleum. The tomb was sealed forever after the collapse.
